```yaml
name: Integration Tests with .NET Aspire

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "develop", "v*"]
    paths: ["src/**", ".github/workflows/integration-tests.yml"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main", "develop"]
    paths: ["src/**", ".github/workflows/integration-tests.yml"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  integration-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          global-json-file: src/global.json

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: latest

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm i -g pnpm

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build -c Release

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test -c Release --no-build

      - name: Validate Aspire projects
        run: |
          # Verify AppHost project builds
          dotnet build "src/GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj" -c Release
          
          # Verify ServiceDefaults project builds
          dotnet build "src/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj" -c Release
          
          # Verify main project builds
          dotnet build "src/GZCTF/GZCTF.csproj" -c Release

      - name: Verify project references
        run: |
          # Check that all projects reference each other correctly
          dotnet list "src/GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj" reference
          dotnet list "src/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj" reference
          dotnet list "src/GZCTF/GZCTF.csproj" reference

      - name: Validate configuration
        run: |
          # Check that AppHost configuration exists
          ls -la "src/GZCTF.AppHost/appsettings.json"
          ls -la "src/GZCTF.AppHost/appsettings.Development.json"
          
          # Check that ServiceDefaults configuration exists
          ls -la "src/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs"

      - name: Verify backward compatibility
        run: |
          # Ensure traditional build still works
          dotnet build "src/GZCTF/GZCTF.csproj" -c Release --no-restore
          
          # Verify no breaking changes in core functionality
          dotnet publish "src/GZCTF/GZCTF.csproj" -c Release -o publish/test --no-self-contained

      - name: Documentation check
        run: |
          # Verify documentation files exist
          ls -la "docs/ASPIRE.md"
          ls -la "docs/ASPIRE_SUMMARY.md"
          ls -la "docs/ASPIRE_SECURITY.md"
          ls -la "docs/ASPIRE_TESTING.md"
          ls -la "docs/aspire-deployment.md"
```
